findings.evidence: All nine declarations precede the `### The simple reflection at a vertex` section and use only the existing Euler/Tits forms, `Pi.single`, finite sums/cards, and looplessness; none uses `Module.preReflection` or any declaration from `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Reflection`.
findings.fix: Move lines 60–142 to `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Quiver/EulerForm.lean`; keep `Reflection.lean` for `vertexReflection` and subsequent results.
findings.issue: The declarations `eulerForm_single_left`, `eulerForm_single_right`, `eulerForm_single_single`, `titsForm_single`, `titsForm_single_of_isEmpty`, `titsPolarForm_single_left`, `titsPolarForm_single_right`, `titsPolarForm_single_single`, and `titsPolarForm_single_self_of_isEmpty` are general form computations placed in the later reflection module, so users of the Euler/Tits API must import reflection machinery unnecessarily.

summary: The reflection API is naturally placed, but the general Euler/Tits-form computations belong in the earlier EulerForm module.
